items.title: Sandisk (SNDK) Dropped, So What Is Behind Its Latest Move?
items.summary: Sandisk (SNDK) just posted first quarter earnings that sharply reshaped the story around the stock, reporting revenue of US$11.0b and net income of US$8.1b, along with fresh guidance for early 2027. Despite Sandisk’s huge 216.66% total shareholder return over the past year, momentum has reversed sharply.
